_doc: First live coverage of the multi-source ingest path (webscraper + in-process document parse since the KAG removal) (source_ingest + brief.sources). A generic project whose brief.sources lists two public IANA-reserved demo URLs makes the opt-in source_ingest leaf actually call kag.test to scrape each; pause_after_stages:[source_ingest] fires ONLY the ingest (plus the concurrent no-dep brief_intake) and pauses before script_draft — no LLM, no TTS, no render, no compile, so this is a cheap live guard. Stage assertions prove BOTH sources were ingested (sources_ingested >= 2) and real grounding text came back (grounding_text nonempty) — a green `paused` alone would not catch a regression where source_ingest silently no-ops or KAG returns empty. Uses example.com/example.org (IANA-reserved demo domains, stable forever, same as app_review/website_review). Uses the already-provisioned E2E_LICENSE_TOKEN — no new secret. The authenticated-source + dedicated-ACG-provider variants need a per-tenant credential provisioned by ops and stay deferred.
